blocks.tamil_translation: 3. He commanded me to preserve the bond of kinship with my relatives even if they turn away from me, 4. He commanded me not to ask anyone for anything, 5. He commanded me to speak only the truth even if it is bitter to people, 6. He commanded me not to fear anyone's blame in spreading the Din of Allah Ta'ala and His commands, 7. He also commanded me to recite abundantly the Kalimah (لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ), because these words are from the treasure beneath the Arsh,” the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- It means that for one who regularly recites this Kalimah, a reward and good of immeasurably high rank are being preserved.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ ﵁ اَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَاطِعٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب اثم القاطع، رقم:٥٩٨٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jubair ibn Mut'im (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “The one who cuts off ties of kinship will not enter Jannah.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Cutting off the ties of kinship is such a grave sin before Allah Ta'ala that no one can enter Jannah with the stain of this sin. However, if he is given the punishment for it and purified of that stain, or if he is forgiven for some reason, he can enter Jannah.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَة ﵁ اَنَّ رَجُلاً قَالَ: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! اِنَّ لِيْ
